item.title: Revival House back in action for stacked lineup of cinematic gold on 16mm and 35mm
item.description: Good news for Perth film buffs: The Revival House at The Como Theatre is back in action from Wednesday 25 February following a short maintenance break. item.title: The WA drag racing legend building a 1,000mph rocket car to become the fastest man on Earth
item.description: Most people are starting to slow down in their 70s. Rosco McGlashan OAM is trying to go 1,000 miles per hour. Inside a workshop in Western Australia sits the Aussie Invader 5R — a bi-propellant rocket-powered land speed car designed to break the current world land speed record and push past the mythical 1,000mph barrier…

item.title: WA’s population set to hit 4 million by 2043, new report finds
item.description: Western Australia has officially crossed a defining milestone. In 2024, the state ticked over three million residents — reaching 3,009,838 people in December, before climbing again to 3,043,731 by June 2025.
